page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 104 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The configuration is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local drive storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system installation and persistent data disks. Complementary public IPv4 addresses are not bundled with this server type.

Offering a substantial core count alongside a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, ecs.g6.26xlarge delivers large-scale multi-core capacity within a single instance. Suitable workloads include enterprise backend applications, container hosts, distributed web servers, batch data processing, continuous integration systems, and database nodes that operate without dedicated local disk volumes.
